items.title: Add drawings from a photo
items.steps: Take a photo of a page with a few drawings. Each drawing should be found, cut out along its outline and added to the wall.

items.title: Faint or pale drawings
items.steps: Try pencil sketches or light crayon. Tell us if any drawing is missed or cut out badly.

items.title: Name a drawing
items.steps: Tap a drawing on the wall and give it a name. Close and reopen the app: the name should stay.

items.title: Story book
items.steps: Open Story book, add characters from the wall, pick a place and a kind of story, and read it. Try moving a character.

items.title: Save a story as PDF
items.steps: In a finished story, save the book as a PDF and open it on your phone.

items.title: Back button
items.steps: Open the review sheet and press Android's back button. It should close the sheet, not the app.
